duplicates.reason: The vendored Pingora tree carries inherited duplicate crates that re-resolve on every run because its lockfile is untracked. The ceiling sits just above the observed count so ordinary resolution churn passes while a dependency change that materially widens duplication fails.

unmaintained.reason: Upstream retains a small number of unmaintained proc-macro and TLS helper crates with no released replacements. The ceiling fails as soon as another one appears.

yanked.reason: Fresh resolution normally avoids yanked releases entirely, but a transitive constraint can pin one. At most a single yanked crate may be tolerated before the build fails.
